caption: The drawing depicts a repeating pattern composed of floral elements and ornate shapes. The primary objects in the image are baskets filled with flowers, including prominent blooms in shades of pink and coral with accents of white and black, nestled among brownish-green leaves that are clustered in groups and cover much of the background. In between the flower baskets, there are large curved ornamental motifs colored in a coral pink shade, decorated with intricate red scrollwork edges and a floral pattern within. The background is a light beige or cream color, covered in small black speckles, which contrasts with the darker brown and the bright coral colors. The pattern is organized in a diagonal arrangement, repeating the floral baskets and ornate shapes across the composition. The overall color palette consists of brown, pink, coral, beige, black, and red.
title: Chintz
